map.fog.tiles.doc: its tiles, 32 x 32 bytes each: identifies a map

map.discover.signature: void(void* map, const float* xz, float range)
map.discover.doc: uncovers the map's fog in a circle of range / 2 metres around xz (the world position), called each frame by fog_of_war with the player's discoveryRange (re/map.md)

map.paintCircle.signature: std::uint32_t(std::uint8_t* tile, std::uint32_t originX, std::uint32_t originZ, float x, float z, float radius, float hardness)
map.paintCircle.doc: raises one 32 x 32 tile's bytes to a circle (map pixels of 8 m; 255 inside, fading to 0 over radius / hardness at its rim), non-zero when a byte rose; a dispatcher to the SSE, AVX2 or AVX-512 version (re/map.md)
